Bash command: cycle.js:114 builds `relay precheck -C <wt> && (<check>)` for the worker, the fixers and the checker, and the
delegate SKILL.md:61 Check line says the same. No text says that this command may run longer than 4 minutes, so the limits
recipe (detached + bounded waits) is not applied up front. The brief's first pass case ("240 s at load 32 leaves the
precheck green") is met by the library but not where it is used: the Bash tool's 240 s cut-off hits first. The red-with-a-reason
of before becomes a cut-off with no reason plus a rerun: waste on every loaded run (principle 2: repeating waste is MEDIUM).

failing_case: A worker at load 32 runs its quiet check `relay precheck -C <wt> && (pytest -q ...)` in the foreground, Bash timeout 240000 ms
(the limits rule). The 16 changed test files take 240 s, the other steps about 10 s. Now: the precheck would be green at
about 250 s, but the Bash tool cuts the call off at 240 s; the agent sees a timeout with no precheck line, then (per the limits
text) reruns it detached: one more 250 s run. Before this change the same run ended red at 230 s with a message. Should: the
agent gets the precheck's green verdict from one run.
fix_hint: In cycle.js, wrap the relay-mode quiet check in a line that says it can take more than 4 minutes on a busy machine and must be
run detached with a log and waited on in calls under 4 minutes (the limits recipe); assert it in tests/test_cycle_workflow.py.
Alternatively name `relay precheck` among the long jobs in the limits text the agents carry.
pass_cases: 1. The quiet-check text an agent gets in relay mode (cycle.js quiet() or the prompt around it) tells it to run the precheck
detached with a log and wait in calls under 4 minutes (or the limits part names `relay precheck` as a long job); a
tests/test_cycle_workflow.py case asserts that wording in the worker, fixer and checker prompts.
2. Changed tests that pass in 240 s leave `relay precheck` green (CHANGED_TESTS_TIMEOUT >= 600, unchanged).
3. A changed test that hangs is still stopped at CHANGED_TESTS_TIMEOUT and reported "took longer than N s" (test_precheck.py:271 stays green).
4. Project mode (no .relay/) keeps the unit's own check text unchanged (test_cycle_workflow.py:104/116 stay green).
findings.summary: the precheck may now run past the 4-minute foreground command limit, but the quiet check every agent runs in the foreground does not say to run it detached: at load the Bash call is cut off with no verdict
